description: Land Title Settlement Department - Matiyanpotha, Reedigama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420082
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, cadastral map references, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, property registrations, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
